snippet.title: Granvir Trailer
snippet.description:
Granvir is a mech-building roguelite under development. Check it out and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743460/Granvir/

Play the early-access demo for free on itch.io: https://bronze-johnson.itch.io/granvir

Join the Discord for development updates: https://discord.gg/rbp5qprgjP
